name: WD repeat domain 73

function.text: WDR73 is the approved symbol for WD repeat domain 73. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in protein-macromolecule adaptor activity; cytoplasmic microtubule organization; nucleus organization.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include Galloway-Mowat syndrome 1 (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Breast carcinoma; Colorectal carcinoma; Clear cell renal cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.
